messages:
Maya Chen: quick noon watch update — re: the intermittent 503s we saw this morning.
incident-bot: PAGE opened INC-3492 at 11:18 UTC (auto-detected elevated 5xx rate on embeddings ingestion).
Maya Chen: tl;dr: root cause candidate = KV cache pressure exacerbated by a recent batcher change. mitigation = rollback + scale. errors back to baseline by ~11:28.
Maya Chen: timeline: 11:12 first spike, 11:18 pager (INC-3492), 11:22 rolled back batcher patch, 11:24 scaled rw-dedicated-pool +2 GPUs, 11:28 error rate dropped.
Alex L.: ack. I'm primary for the shift, taking point on post-incident follow-ups.
Samir R.: standing by as secondary — I can pick up any follow-ups later today.
Maya Chen: customer impact: partner-api-3 saw ~15% request timeouts and elevated p95 (2–3s extra). CS ticket TKT-778 created; CS looped in. No billing or data-loss reports so far.
Leah - SRE: I'm on call until 14:00 UTC, then offline until 18:00 — partial coverage gap 16:00–17:00 if nobody overlaps. flagging now so we can get a volunteer.
Maya Chen: runbooks and artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-pressure (diagnostics) and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/batcher-rollback (rollback steps). I pushed dashboards to the INC-3492 thread.
Maya Chen: commands used to rollback (for reference): ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/batcher-service``` and ```./infra/scale-dedicated --pool rw-dedicated-pool --delta 2```
Alex L.: noted. Action items I'm taking: (1) draft postmortem, (2) assign autoscaler tuning to reduce sensitivity to short bursts, (3) review batching change for safety checks.
Maya Chen: other follow-ups: collect traces/logs for 11:00–12:00 window and attach to INC-3492; validate that prefix/KV cache metrics align with the spike.
Samir R.: I can pick up the autoscaler PR if you want, Alex — I have bandwidth after 16:00 and can cover 16:00–17:00 if nobody else volunteers.
Leah - SRE: thanks — I can cover until 14:00 and be reachable via slack for critical pages while offline, but won't be able to do full mitigation work between 15:00–17:00.
incident-bot: Pager INC-3492 marked RESOLVED at 12:05 UTC (manual close by Maya Chen). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3492
Maya Chen: I'm attaching a short checklist to INC-3492: traces + dashboards (Maya), postmortem draft (Alex), autoscaler PR (Samir), runbook updates (Alex/Maya).
Alex L.: I'll create the postmortem draft in the repo and tag @Maya and @Samir for review.
Samir R.: will open a PR for autoscaler threshold tuning and add unit tests to simulate short bursts.
Maya Chen: one operational note: we've temporarily increased autoscaler thresholds and the scaling buffer — will revert after tuning PR lands. Watch p95 for 2h.
Alex L.: volunteers for 16:00–17:00? otherwise Samir has offered. If anyone can cover earlier gap between 15:30–16:00 please say so.
Maya Chen: tagging @Leah for overlap reminder. :thumbsup:
Leah - SRE: acknowledged.
Maya Chen: final status: stable, monitoring, customer notified (TKT-778), actions assigned. Next status update in this thread if anything changes.
Alex L.: thanks everyone. leaving this thread for the oncoming evening watch — I'll post the postmortem link once drafted.
Maya Chen: thanks — closing my logs here, will update INC-3492 in 1–2 hours with trace attachments.
Samir R.: copy, standing by for handoff if needed.
incident-bot: Reminder: runbook review due in 7 days for playbook used in INC-3492.
Maya Chen: noted, adding runbook review to the postmortem action items.
